latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator Adobe — Auto-Generate and Burn In Captions.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB to generate AI-powered burned-in captions.
- No need for Adobe Premiere; cloud-based processing delivers 1080p MP4 files in 30-60 seconds.
- Supports file upload, caption generation, balance checking, timeline state, and direct exports.
- Manages backend authentication automatically, including free token setup.
- Responds to both English and Chinese commands for common actions.
- Includes error handling for unsupported files, oversized uploads, and account credits.
